title: 分段鏡共相控制
summary: 以 Keck 10 m 主鏡的 36 片段鏡、108 支致動器與 168 個邊緣感測器為主軸，並對照 ELT 的 798 片段鏡，理解如何把數十片獨立鏡面維持在同一個波前上：從 piston 誤差與 Strehl、可觀測性、感測器漂移、寬頻與雙波長共相，到控制迴路與段鏡更換後的重新共相。
summaryEn: Built around the Keck 10 m primary with 36 segments, 108 actuators and 168 edge sensors, and compared with the ELT's 798 segments, this course shows how dozens of separate mirrors are held on one wavefront: from piston error and Strehl, observability and sensor drift, to broadband and dual-wavelength phasing, control loops and re-phasing after segment exchange.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 共相預算練習：假設一面 36 片、對角 1.8 m 段鏡的主鏡要在 1.65 µm 維持 Strehl ≥ 0.95。允許的表面 piston σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.95) = 1650/12.57 × 0.2265 ≈ 29.7 nm。分配感測器雜訊 3 nm、漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(9 + 225 + 100 + 4 + 225) ≈ 23.7 nm，低於 29.7 nm，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4π × 23.7/1650)²] ≈ 0.97。新段鏡安裝後誤差 12 µm：窄頻 0.85 µm 的唯一範圍只有 ±0.21 µm，雙波長 Λ = 13.6 µm 的 ±3.4 µm 也不夠，必須先以約 ±30 µm 捕獲範圍的寬頻方法定位。168 個感測器對 105 個可控自由度約 1.6 倍過定。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: Phasing-budget exercise: a primary of 36 segments, each 1.8 m across corners, must hold Strehl ≥ 0.95 at 1.65 µm. The allowed surface piston is σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.95) = 1650/12.57 × 0.2265 ≈ 29.7 nm. Allocating 3 nm sensor noise, 15 nm drift, 10 nm phasing camera, 2 nm actuators and 15 nm wind gives RSS = √(9 + 225 + 100 + 4 + 225) ≈ 23.7 nm, inside 29.7 nm, with Strehl ≈ exp[−(4π × 23.7/1650)²] ≈ 0.97. A newly installed segment is off by 12 µm: the 0.85 µm narrowband range of ±0.21 µm and even the ±3.4 µm of a 13.6 µm synthetic wavelength are insufficient, so a broadband method with roughly ±30 µm capture must locate it first. The 168 sensors over-determine the 105 controllable degrees of freedom about 1.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差」與「感測架構、可觀測性與 2π 模糊的根源」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error" and "Sensing architecture, observability and the origin of 2π ambiguity": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。只有當所有段鏡的高度（piston）與傾斜誤差遠小於波長時，各段反射的光才會在焦點同相疊加，得到 10 m 口徑的繞射極限；否則每片只像一台 1.8 m 的獨立望遠鏡，能量散進寬度約 λ/d 的段鏡繞射暈。反射使表面高度誤差在波前上加倍，所以共相要求是奈米級的表面精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere. Only when every segment's height (piston) and tilt errors are far below the wavelength does light from all segments add in phase at focus to give the diffraction limit of a 10 m aperture; otherwise each segment behaves like a separate 1.8 m telescope and energy spreads into a segment-diffraction halo of width about λ/d. Reflection doubles surface height errors in the wavefront, so phasing demands nanometre-level surface accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每片段鏡的面形都合格，拼起來的主鏡自然就是繞射極限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every segment's figure passes, the assembled primary is automatically diffraction limited." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：波前誤差 = 2 × 表面 piston，Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]。σ_s = 30 nm 時，2.2 µm 的 Strehl ≈ 0.97、1.0 µm 約 0.87、0.5 µm 約 0.57。要在 2.2 µm 維持 0.9，σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.9) ≈ 57 nm；在 0.5 µm 則需 ≤ 13 nm。段鏡繞射暈寬度與核心之比約 D/d = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.6。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wavefront error equals twice the surface piston, so Strehl ≈ exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]. For σ_s = 30 nm the Strehl is about 0.97 at 2.2 µm, 0.87 at 1.0 µm and 0.57 at 0.5 µm. Holding 0.9 at 2.2 µm requires σ_s ≤ λ/(4π)·√(−ln 0.9) ≈ 57 nm, and at 0.5 µm σ_s ≤ 13 nm. The segment halo is wider than the core by about D/d = 10/1.8 ≈ 5.6. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照；同時在瞳面以共相相機直接量每一條段鏡邊界的階差，把量到的 σ_s 代回公式預測 Strehl，兩種量測互相驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation; at the same time measure the step at every intersegment edge with the phasing camera in the pupil, insert the measured σ_s into the formula to predict Strehl, and cross-check the two measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 分段孔徑的繞射與 piston 誤差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segmented-aperture diffraction and piston error: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在焦面以窄頻濾光片拍攝亮星，比較影像核心與段鏡繞射暈的能量比，與由 Strehl 公式推算的 piston 殘差對照；同時在瞳面以共相相機直接量每一條段鏡邊界的階差，把量到的 σ_s 代回公式預測 Strehl，兩種量測互相驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image a bright star through a narrowband filter at focus and compare the energy ratio between core and segment halo with the piston residual inferred from the Strehl relation; at the same time measure the step at every intersegment edge with the phasing camera in the pupil, insert the measured σ_s into the formula to predict Strehl, and cross-check the two measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.objective: 說明「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。邊緣感測器只量相對值，所以整面鏡的整體 piston、tip、tilt 無法觀測，必須交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距；另有一種讓所有段鏡沿徑向微傾、等效改變主鏡曲率的模態，只靠感測器對兩鏡夾角的微弱靈敏度觀測，雜訊放大最大。感測器只能維持相對位置，絕對的共相零點必須由光學量測給定，而光學相位只在一個波長內唯一，這就是 2π 模糊的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.objective: 說明「電容式邊緣感測器」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Capacitive edge sensor” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Keck 使用電容式邊緣感測器：一片段鏡邊緣裝驅動電極，相鄰段鏡裝感測電極，兩片的相對高度改變重疊面積或間隙，進而改變電容。奈米級解析對應的電容變化只有 aF 等級，所以感測器採差動或比例量測並以鎖相偵測抑制雜訊。真正困難的是長期穩定：支架熱膨脹、空氣濕度改變介電常數與電極污染都會產生看似真實的高度變化，而控制迴路會忠實地把這些漂移變成真實的段鏡移動。ELT 的感測器另外量測段鏡間隙與剪切。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容式邊緣感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Keck uses capacitive edge sensors: a drive electrode on one segment's edge faces a sense electrode on its neighbour, and a change in relative height alters overlap area or gap and hence capacitance. Nanometre resolution corresponds to attofarad changes, so the sensors use differential or ratiometric measurement with lock-in detection to suppress noise. The real difficulty is long-term stability: bracket thermal expansion, humidity-driven changes in air permittivity and electrode contamination all create apparent height changes, and the control loop faithfully converts these drifts into real segment motion. The ELT sensors additionally measure intersegment gap and shear. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Capacitive edge sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器解析度達 1 nm，主鏡位置就能長期維持在 1 nm。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 邊緣感測器：靈敏度、溫濕度漂移與安裝：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電容式邊緣感測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：剪切式電容 C = ε₀·w·h/g：電極寬 w = 50 mm、重疊高 h = 10 mm、間隙 g = 2 mm（教學假設），C ≈ 2.2 pF，dC/dh = ε₀·w/g ≈ 0.22 aF/nm，1 nm 對應 ΔC/C ≈ 1×10⁻⁷。支架長 50 mm、CTE 1 ppm/K 時每 1 K 漂移約 50 nm；改用 Zerodur（0.05 ppm/K）則約 2.5 nm/K，說明安裝材料與溫度補償的必要。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

A 50 mm bracket with CTE 1 ppm/K drifts about 50 nm per kelvin, whereas Zerodur at 0.05 ppm/K gives about 2.5 nm/K, showing why mounting material and temperature compensation matter. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在溫濕度可控的測試台上把一對感測器固定在已知相對位置，掃描溫度與濕度並記錄輸出，求溫度係數與濕度係數；再以干涉儀作參考掃描相對高度，得到增益與線性度；安裝後長期比對感測器讀數與共相相機量測之差，估計實際漂移率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a test stand with controlled temperature and humidity, fix a sensor pair at a known relative position, sweep temperature and humidity, and record the output to obtain temperature and humidity coefficients; scan the relative height against an interferometer reference to obtain gain and linearity; after installation, compare sensor readings with phasing-camera measurements over the long term to estimate the real drift rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲；另有 warping harness 以小彈簧力修正段鏡本身的低階面形，ELT 每片 9 支。位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight; a warping harness applies small spring forces to correct the segment's own low-order figure, nine per ELT segment. The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 段鏡支撐：致動器行程、剛性與面形修正：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ELT 致動器公開規格為 10 mm 行程、2 nm 精度，動態範圍 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²²，需 23 位元以上的位置控制。風載：ELT 段鏡對角 1.4 m、面積約 1.27 m²，圓頂內風速 3 m/s、空氣密度 0.9 kg/m³，動壓 0.5ρv² ≈ 4.1 Pa、總力約 5.2 N；若 30% 為擾動，1.5 N 在 100 N/µm 的支撐剛性（教學假設）下造成約 15 nm 的 piston 抖動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The published ELT actuator figures are 10 mm stroke and 2 nm accuracy, a dynamic range of 10 mm/2 nm = 5×10⁶ ≈ 2²², needing position control beyond 23 bits. Wind: an ELT segment 1.4 m across corners has about 1.27 m² of area; with 3 m/s wind inside the dome and air density 0.9 kg/m³ the dynamic pressure 0.5ρv² ≈ 4.1 Pa gives about 5.2 N; if 30% of that fluctuates, 1.5 N on a 100 N/µm support stiffness (teaching assumption) produces about 15 nm of piston jitter. steps.observation: 如何核對：在測試台以干涉儀量致動器的步進、遲滯與長期蠕變，並以激振器量段鏡在支撐上的頻率響應，取得剛性與第一共振頻率；在望遠鏡上比對風速計讀數與邊緣感測器高頻頻譜的相關性，估計風載項的大小。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On a test stand measure actuator steps, hysteresis and long-term creep with an interferometer, and measure the frequency response of the segment on its support with a shaker to obtain stiffness and first resonance; on the telescope correlate anemometer readings with the high-frequency spectrum of the edge sensors to size the wind term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 致動器遲滯或背隙使小步修正失效，控制迴路持續在兩個位置間跳動形成極限環，感測器讀數呈鋸齒狀；whiffletree 樞軸卡滯時段鏡在仰角變化下產生像散，即使三點位置正確，該段的繞射暈仍異常明亮。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Actuator hysteresis or backlash defeats small corrections, the loop hops between two positions in a limit cycle and sensor readings show a sawtooth; a sticking whiffletree pivot lets the segment develop astigmatism as elevation changes, so its diffraction halo stays unusually bright even though its three-point position is correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「致動器精度夠高，就不必在意支撐剛性與風。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With accurate enough actuators, support stiffness and wind do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Keck 的共相相機在瞳面放置跨越段鏡邊界的小圓孔，每個孔同時收集兩片段鏡的光並形成一個繞射影像，兩片之間的 piston 階差會改變干涉圖樣的形狀。單一窄頻波長下，相位只在 λ/2（表面）範圍內唯一，超出就產生 2π 模糊；寬頻光的相干長度短，干涉對比隨階差衰減，可在數十微米範圍內粗略定出零點；雙波長則以合成波長 Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| 擴大唯一範圍。實務上先寬頻捕獲，再窄頻精調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Keck phasing camera places small circular apertures across intersegment edges in the pupil; each aperture collects light from two segments and forms one diffraction image whose shape changes with the piston step between them. At a single narrowband wavelength the phase is unique only within λ/2 of surface height, beyond which the 2π ambiguity appears; broadband light has a short coherence length, so fringe contrast decays with step size and locates the zero coarsely over tens of micrometres; two wavelengths form a synthetic wavelength Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| that extends the unique range. In practice segments are captured broadband first and then refined narrowband. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：窄頻 λ = 0.85 µm：表面唯一範圍 ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Narrowband at λ = 0.85 µm: the unique surface range is ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一波長的干涉量測就能唯一決定任意大小的段鏡階差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Single-wavelength interferometry uniquely determines a segment step of any size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：窄頻 λ = 0.85 µm：表面唯一範圍 ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm。雙波長 0.80 與 0.85 µm：Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm，表面範圍擴到 ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm。寬頻 Δλ = 0.2 µm 的相干長度 L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm；Keck 寬頻演算法以多組濾光片把捕獲範圍擴到 ±30 µm，並收斂到約 30 nm 殘差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Narrowband at λ = 0.85 µm: the unique surface range is ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm. Dual wavelength at 0.80 and 0.85 µm: Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm, extending the surface range to ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm. Broadband with Δλ = 0.2 µm has coherence length L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm; the Keck broadband algorithm uses several filters to extend capture to ±30 µm and converges to about 30 nm residual. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：刻意把一片段鏡推出已知的 piston（例如 +1 µm、+5 µm、+20 µm），分別以窄頻、雙波長與寬頻方法量測，確認每種方法在唯一範圍內回推值正確、超出時出現預期的折疊；再以重複量測統計共相相機本身的重複性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 窄頻 λ = 0.85 µm：表面唯一範圍 ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm。雙波長 0.80 與 0.85 µm：Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm，表面範圍擴到 ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm。寬頻 Δλ = 0.2 µm 的相干長度 L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm；Keck 寬頻演算法以多組濾光片把捕獲範圍擴到 ±30 µm，並收斂到約 30 nm 殘差。
knowledge.textEn: Narrowband at λ = 0.85 µm: the unique surface range is ±λ/4 ≈ ±0.21 µm. Dual wavelength at 0.80 and 0.85 µm: Λ = 0.80 × 0.85/0.05 = 13.6 µm, extending the surface range to ±Λ/4 = ±3.4 µm. Broadband with Δλ = 0.2 µm has coherence length L_c ≈ λ²/Δλ ≈ 3.6 µm; the Keck broadband algorithm uses several filters to extend capture to ±30 µm and converges to about 30 nm residual.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

Exchanging a segment is purely mechanical; putting it back needs no re-phasing.

steps.title: 光學共相量測：窄頻、寬頻與雙波長：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical phasing: narrowband, broadband and dual-wavelength: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 刻意把一片段鏡推出已知的 piston（例如 +1 µm、+5 µm、+20 µm），分別以窄頻、雙波長與寬頻方法量測，確認每種方法在唯一範圍內回推值正確、超出時出現預期的折疊；再以重複量測統計共相相機本身的重複性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只用窄頻量測一片剛裝上、piston 誤差 0.5 µm 的段鏡，波前誤差 1.0 µm 被折疊成看似 0.075 µm 的小誤差，控制器修正後段鏡穩定鎖在錯誤的條紋上，相鄰段鏡也被重建器拉偏，整面鏡出現難以診斷的階梯。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring a newly installed segment with 0.5 µm of piston using narrowband light alone folds its 1.0 µm wavefront error into an apparent 0.075 µm, the controller locks the segment onto the wrong fringe, the reconstructor drags its neighbours off as well, and the mirror develops a hard-to-diagnose staircase.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 刻意把一片段鏡推出已知的 piston（例如 +1 µm、+5 µm、+20 µm），分別以窄頻、雙波長與寬頻方法量測，確認每種方法在唯一範圍內回推值正確、超出時出現預期的折疊；再以重複量測統計共相相機本身的重複性。
knowledge.textEn: Deliberately offset one segment by known pistons such as +1 µm, +5 µm and +20 µm, measure each with the narrowband, dual-wavelength and broadband methods, and confirm that each method recovers the value inside its unique range and folds as expected outside it; then use repeated measurements to establish the phasing camera's own repeatability.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算：原理與系統邊界

steps.instruction: 共相相機只能在望遠鏡指向亮星時偶爾使用，平時主鏡靠邊緣感測器的設定點維持形狀：先以光學量測把主鏡共相，再記錄當時全部感測器的讀數作為目標值，迴路此後只負責維持這組讀數。因此誤差預算包含感測器雜訊經重建器放大的項、兩次校正之間的感測器漂移、共相相機的量測誤差、致動器解析度與風載擾動；各項以均方根相加後換算成 Strehl，並據此決定校正的頻率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The phasing camera can be used only occasionally while the telescope points at a bright star, so most of the time the mirror is held by edge-sensor set points: the primary is phased optically, every sensor reading at that moment is recorded as its target, and the loop thereafter only maintains those readings. steps.title: 感測器設定點校正與共相誤差預算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sensor set-points and phasing budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面 piston RMS 預算（教學假設）：感測器雜訊經放大 3 nm、校正間漂移 15 nm、共相相機 10 nm、致動器 2 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS ≈ 24 nm。Strehl = exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²]：2.2 µm 約 0.98、1.65 µm 約 0.97、1.0 µm 約 0.91。若漂移項增為 40 nm，RSS ≈ 44 nm，1.0 µm 的 Strehl 降到約 0.74，就是需要更頻繁校正的訊號。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Surface piston RMS budget (teaching assumption): amplified sensor noise 3 nm, drift between calibrations 15 nm, phasing camera 10 nm, actuators 2 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS ≈ 24 nm. Strehl = exp[−(4πσ_s/λ)²] is about 0.98 at 2.2 µm, 0.97 at 1.65 µm and 0.91 at 1.0 µm. If drift grows to 40 nm, RSS ≈ 44 nm and Strehl at 1.0 µm falls to about 0.74, the signal that calibration must become more frequent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在兩次完整校正之間每隔數小時抽量部分段鏡邊界，畫實測階差對時間、溫度與濕度的漂移曲線；把長期統計填入預算表各項，檢查漂移項是否主導，據此訂出重新校正的間隔與觸發條件，例如溫度變化超過某個門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Between full calibrations, spot-check a subset of edges every few hours and plot measured steps against time, temperature and humidity; enter long-term statistics into each budget line, check whether drift dominates, and set the recalibration interval and triggers, such as a temperature change beyond a threshold, accordingly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.titleEn: Sensor set-point calibration and the phasing error budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Sensor set-points and phasing budget” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若校正只在溫度穩定的夜晚做一次就長期沿用，感測器溫度係數造成的漂移隨季節累積，影像品質逐月下降，而所有感測器讀數仍緊貼設定點，讓人誤以為主鏡狀態良好。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If calibration is done once on a thermally stable night and then reused indefinitely, drift from the sensors' temperature coefficients accumulates with the seasons and image quality declines month by month, while every sensor still sits on its set point and the mirror appears healthy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此誤差預算包含感測器雜訊經重建器放大的項、兩次校正之間的感測器漂移、共相相機的量測誤差、致動器解析度與風載擾動；各項以均方根相加後換算成 Strehl，並據此決定校正的頻率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The error budget therefore contains sensor noise amplified by the reconstructor, sensor drift between calibrations, phasing-camera measurement error, actuator resolution and wind disturbance, added root-sum-square and converted to Strehl to decide how often to recalibrate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「共相只需要在建造完成時做一次，之後感測器會永遠維持。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Phasing is done once at commissioning and the sensors maintain it forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制迴路整合：重建器、頻寬與卸載」與「段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Loop integration: reconstructor, bandwidth and offloading" and "Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制迴路整合：重建器、頻寬與卸載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Loop integration: reconstructor, bandwidth and offloading: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active control system and AO interface” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主鏡主動控制系統以固定頻率讀取全部邊緣感測器，乘上重建矩陣得到每支致動器的修正量；重建器排除三個不可觀測模態並對弱模態加權，整體 piston、tip、tilt 交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距。迴路頻寬要高到能抑制重力與溫度造成的緩慢變形，又要遠低於段鏡支撐的結構共振，以免激發機構。下游自適應光學的 Shack–Hartmann 對段鏡邊界的階差幾乎不敏感，所以不能指望 AO 補救共相誤差，兩個系統的分工必須寫進介面文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The primary's active control system reads all edge sensors at a fixed rate and multiplies them by the reconstruction matrix to get each actuator's correction; the reconstructor excludes the three unobservable modes, weights the weak ones, and hands global piston, tip and tilt to telescope pointing and secondary focus. Loop bandwidth must be high enough to reject slow gravity and thermal deformation yet far below the structural resonances of the segment supports so as not to excite them. A downstream adaptive-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor is nearly blind to steps at segment edges, so AO cannot rescue phasing errors, and the division of labour must be written into the interface document. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active control system and AO interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：迴路取樣 10 Hz、交越頻率 f_c = 0.5 Hz（教學假設）：低頻擾動殘留比 |S| ≈ f/f_c，對 0.01 Hz 的溫度漂移為 0.02，即抑制 50 倍；對 1 Hz 的風載 |S| ≈ 1，迴路沒有抑制能力，只能靠支撐剛性。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 10 Hz sampling and a crossover f_c = 0.5 Hz (teaching assumptions), the low-frequency residual ratio |S| ≈ f/f_c is 0.02 for a 0.01 Hz thermal drift, a 50-fold rejection, whereas 1 Hz wind gives |S| ≈ 1, so the loop cannot help and support stiffness must.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自適應光學會自動修掉段鏡之間的階差，所以主鏡共相不必太精確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adaptive optics automatically removes steps between segments, so primary phasing need not be precise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Active control system and AO interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 控制迴路整合：重建器、頻寬與卸載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Loop integration: reconstructor, bandwidth and offloading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active control system and AO interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：迴路取樣 10 Hz、交越頻率 f_c = 0.5 Hz（教學假設）：低頻擾動殘留比 |S| ≈ f/f_c，對 0.01 Hz 的溫度漂移為 0.02，即抑制 50 倍；對 1 Hz 的風載 |S| ≈ 1，迴路沒有抑制能力，只能靠支撐剛性。若段鏡支撐第一共振為 30 Hz，控制頻寬比共振低約 60 倍，穩定裕度充足。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 10 Hz sampling and a crossover f_c = 0.5 Hz (teaching assumptions), the low-frequency residual ratio |S| ≈ f/f_c is 0.02 for a 0.01 Hz thermal drift, a 50-fold rejection, whereas 1 Hz wind gives |S| ≈ 1, so the loop cannot help and support stiffness must. With a first support resonance at 30 Hz, the control bandwidth sits about 60 times below it, leaving ample stability margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在迴路中注入已知頻率的小振幅正弦擾動，量閉迴路的感測器響應求靈敏度函數 S(f)，與模型比較交越頻率與峰值；並比較迴路開閉時的感測器功率譜，確認低頻被抑制、高頻未被放大。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject small sinusoidal disturbances of known frequency into the loop, measure the closed-loop sensor response to obtain the sensitivity function S(f), and compare crossover and peak with the model; compare open- and closed-loop sensor power spectra to confirm that low frequencies are suppressed and high frequencies are not amplified.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

With a first support resonance at 30 Hz, the control bandwidth sits about 60 times below it, leaving ample stability margin.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 控制迴路整合：重建器、頻寬與卸載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Loop integration: reconstructor, bandwidth and offloading: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Active control system and AO interface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在迴路中注入已知頻率的小振幅正弦擾動，量閉迴路的感測器響應求靈敏度函數 S(f)，與模型比較交越頻率與峰值；並比較迴路開閉時的感測器功率譜，確認低頻被抑制、高頻未被放大。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject small sinusoidal disturbances of known frequency into the loop, measure the closed-loop sensor response to obtain the sensitivity function S(f), and compare crossover and peak with the model; compare open- and closed-loop sensor power spectra to confirm that low frequencies are suppressed and high frequencies are not amplified. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：迴路增益調到交越頻率接近支撐共振時，感測器出現持續的窄頻振盪，所有段鏡一起微幅抖動，長曝光影像被抹寬；若重建器未排除整體 tip/tilt，主鏡控制與望遠鏡導星迴路互相拉扯，導星殘差出現緩慢的極限環。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Raising the gain until crossover approaches a support resonance produces a persistent narrowband oscillation in the sensors, all segments shiver together and long exposures blur; if the reconstructor does not exclude global tip/tilt, primary control and the telescope guiding loop fight each other and the guide residual shows a slow limit cycle.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在迴路中注入已知頻率的小振幅正弦擾動，量閉迴路的感測器響應求靈敏度函數 S(f)，與模型比較交越頻率與峰值；並比較迴路開閉時的感測器功率譜，確認低頻被抑制、高頻未被放大。
knowledge.textEn: Inject small sinusoidal disturbances of known frequency into the loop, measure the closed-loop sensor response to obtain the sensitivity function S(f), and compare crossover and peak with the model; compare open- and closed-loop sensor power spectra to confirm that low frequencies are suppressed and high frequencies are not amplified.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制迴路整合：重建器、頻寬與卸載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Loop integration: reconstructor, bandwidth and offloading"?

quiz.explanation: 在迴路中注入已知頻率的小振幅正弦擾動，量閉迴路的感測器響應求靈敏度函數 S(f)，與模型比較交越頻率與峰值；並比較迴路開閉時的感測器功率譜，確認低頻被抑制、高頻未被放大。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。

steps.title: 控制迴路整合：重建器、頻寬與卸載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Loop integration: reconstructor, bandwidth and offloading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Active control system and AO interface” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 迴路增益調到交越頻率接近支撐共振時，感測器出現持續的窄頻振盪，所有段鏡一起微幅抖動，長曝光影像被抹寬；若重建器未排除整體 tip/tilt，主鏡控制與望遠鏡導星迴路互相拉扯，導星殘差出現緩慢的極限環。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Raising the gain until crossover approaches a support resonance produces a persistent narrowband oscillation in the sensors, all segments shiver together and long exposures blur; if the reconstructor does not exclude global tip/tilt, primary control and the telescope guiding loop fight each other and the guide residual shows a slow limit cycle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下游自適應光學的 Shack–Hartmann 對段鏡邊界的階差幾乎不敏感，所以不能指望 AO 補救共相誤差，兩個系統的分工必須寫進介面文件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A downstream adaptive-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor is nearly blind to steps at segment edges, so AO cannot rescue phasing errors, and the division of labour must be written into the interface document.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自適應光學會自動修掉段鏡之間的階差，所以主鏡共相不必太精確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adaptive optics automatically removes steps between segments, so primary phasing need not be precise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「段鏡更換與影像驗收」如何決定分段鏡共相控制的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment exchange and image acceptance” determines the key performance of “Segmented-mirror co-phasing control”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分段主鏡的鍍膜會老化，必須輪流把段鏡拆下重鍍再裝回；更換後新段鏡的位置只準到數十微米，必須先以寬頻共相捕獲、再以窄頻精調，並重新設定與它相關的所有邊緣感測器零點。驗收要同時看光學量測（共相相機殘差、焦面影像的段鏡繞射暈）與感測器健康（雜訊、漂移、失效感測器的處理），失效的感測器要從重建器移除並重算矩陣。交接文件需列出每片段鏡的序號與位置、感測器設定點版本、重建矩陣版本與更換紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment coatings age, so segments are removed, recoated and reinstalled in rotation; after exchange a new segment is positioned only to tens of micrometres and must be captured broadband, refined narrowband, and have the zero points of every associated edge sensor reset. Acceptance looks at optical measurements, namely phasing-camera residuals and the segment halo in focal-plane images, and at sensor health, namely noise, drift and handling of failed sensors, which must be removed from the reconstructor with the matrix recomputed. The handoff file lists each segment's serial number and position, the set-point version, the reconstructor version and the exchange log. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Segment exchange and image acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ELT 共 931 片段鏡（含 133 片備品），每 18 個月全鏡重鍍一輪，平均 798/(18 × 30.4 天) ≈ 1.5 片/天，ESO 規劃約每天兩片。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The ELT has 931 segments including 133 spares, and the whole mirror is recoated every 18 months, an average of 798/(18 × 30.4 days) ≈ 1.5 segments per day, with ESO planning about two per day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「更換段鏡只是機械工作，裝回原位即可，不需重新共相。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Exchanging a segment is purely mechanical; putting it back needs no re-phasing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Segment exchange and image acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment exchange and image acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ELT 共 931 片段鏡（含 133 片備品），每 18 個月全鏡重鍍一輪，平均 798/(18 × 30.4 天) ≈ 1.5 片/天，ESO 規劃約每天兩片。每片段鏡最多 6 條邊、12 個感測器需重設零點；若每片重新共相需 20 分鐘（教學假設），每天約占 30 到 40 分鐘望遠鏡時間，因此流程必須自動化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The ELT has 931 segments including 133 spares, and the whole mirror is recoated every 18 months, an average of 798/(18 × 30.4 days) ≈ 1.5 segments per day, with ESO planning about two per day. Each segment has up to 6 edges and 12 sensors whose zeros must be reset; if re-phasing takes 20 minutes per segment (teaching assumption), that costs 30 to 40 minutes of telescope time per day, so the procedure must be automated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常；每月彙整所有段鏡的共相殘差、感測器漂移率與失效數量，對照交接文件中的基準趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After every exchange run a fixed sequence of mechanical positioning, broadband capture, narrowband refinement and recording of new set points, and confirm with focal-plane images that the segment's halo has returned to normal; each month compile phasing residuals, sensor drift rates and failure counts for all segments and compare them with the baseline trends in the handoff file.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 段鏡更換、重新共相與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Segment exchange, re-phasing and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「段鏡更換與影像驗收」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Segment exchange and image acceptance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常；每月彙整所有段鏡的共相殘差、感測器漂移率與失效數量，對照交接文件中的基準趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After every exchange run a fixed sequence of mechanical positioning, broadband capture, narrowband refinement and recording of new set points, and confirm with focal-plane images that the segment's halo has returned to normal; each month compile phasing residuals, sensor drift rates and failure counts for all segments and compare them with the baseline trends in the handoff file. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：更換段鏡後若忘了更新感測器設定點版本，迴路會把新段鏡推回舊段鏡的位置，造成數百 nm 的階差；若失效感測器沒有從重建器移除，它的固定讀數像一條錯誤的約束，把周圍數片段鏡一起拉歪。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Forgetting to update the set-point version after an exchange makes the loop drive the new segment to the old one's position, leaving a step of hundreds of nanometres; a failed sensor left in the reconstructor acts as a false constraint whose frozen reading drags several surrounding segments askew.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 每次更換後執行固定流程：機械定位、寬頻捕獲、窄頻精調、記錄新設定點，並以焦面影像確認該段鏡的繞射暈恢復正常；每月彙整所有段鏡的共相殘差、感測器漂移率與失效數量，對照交接文件中的基準趨勢。

knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.
